card: SS-2026-11-W1-03 · reel_motion (code-rendered motion graphics, voiced), tier O30 (20 to 35 s) · job reach · belief B2 ('it isn't your fault: the cause is pieces that don't work together') · awareness problem_aware · cta_type send · hook_type hidden_cause · narrow product: clients who bought once don't come back because nobody invites them back; the fix is one message after the work is done in three parts (name the work, ask how it is going, leave the next step open). AI label on (AI voice).
facts:
- The owner's own words: 'klientët nuk kthehen' (clients don't come back); his fear: clients don't come back.
- His situation: busy, works in the business every day; pays for marketing pieces that don't connect.
- The three-part message is a process (a method), never a result. No claim that clients will come back.
- No numbers or counts except the post's own three parts. No names.
hook:
Visual from frame 1: a phone's chat list of past clients (generic, no app styling), each with a plain avatar circle (no names, no numbers). Every thread ends in the client's last bubble, a large readable 'Faleminderit!' (Thank you!), with nothing after it. Hold about 1.2 s, then the threads sink under new chats and drop off the screen.
Text hook (top third, 0-3 s): 'Klientët s'u kthyen. / A i ftoi kush?' [Clients didn't come back. / Did anyone invite them?]
Spoken L1 (fixed): see line 1.
structure: ST3 compact hidden cause, second-person narrator. O30 rungs: recognition (L1), the cause in one picture line (L2, L3), the fix/method (L4, L5), CTA (L6).
actq: Would you send this reel to someone (the person who deals with your clients, a partner, a friend who owns a business)?
end_card: The red phone's chat list, the one lit thread at the top; text 'Dërgoja atij që merret me klientët e tu.' plus the StraightScale wordmark. Held to 32.0 s.

lines.sq: Klientët e vjetër nuk kthehen, dhe ti mendon se gjetën dikë tjetër. Po a i ftoi kush të kthehen?
lines.en: Old clients don't come back, and you think they found someone else. But did anyone invite them back?
lines.super: 0-3 s text hook 'Klientët s'u kthyen. / A i ftoi kush?'; 3.0-8.3 'Gjetën dikë tjetër?' [They found someone else?]
lines.visual: Phone in a deep red case, generic chat list of past clients, every thread ending in a big 'Faleminderit!'; at 1.2 s they sink under new chats and drop off the bottom.

lines.sq: Shiko ku mbaron biseda: te faleminderit. Pas tij, asgjë.
lines.en: Look where the chat ends: at the thank-you. After it, nothing.
lines.super: 'Biseda mbaron te faleminderit' [The chat ends at the thank-you]
lines.visual: One old thread is pulled back up and opened: the work, the delivery, the client's 'Faleminderit!' and below it empty space, scrolling on, still empty.

lines.sq: Sepse puna mbaroi, por askush s'e lidhi me herën tjetër.
lines.en: Because the work ended, but nobody connected it to the next time.
lines.super: 'Puna mbaroi. Askush s'e lidhi.' [The work ended. Nobody connected it.]
lines.visual: A thin red thread runs along the chat from the first message to the 'Faleminderit!' and stops there, its end loose; nothing ties it to anything below.

lines.sq: Pra, pas punës, një mesazh me tri pjesë:
lines.en: So, after the work, one message in three parts:
lines.super: 'Një mesazh, tri pjesë' [One message, three parts]
lines.visual: The owner's hands (from behind, at the showroom counter) type on the red phone; a new message draft appears below the 'Faleminderit!'.

lines.sq: Si po të shërben kuzhina e re? Kur të duhet diçka, më shkruaj këtu.
lines.en: How is the new kitchen serving you? When you need anything, write to me here.
lines.super: The message itself on screen, its three parts tagged as they are said: '1 Puna' [the work] on 'kuzhina e re', '2 Si po shkon' [how it's going] on 'Si po të shërben', '3 Hapi tjetër' [the next step] on 'Kur të duhet diçka, më shkruaj këtu'
lines.visual: The message is sent; the red thread now runs on past 'Faleminderit!' into the new message and stays tied. This thread stays lit at the top while the other old threads keep sinking.

lines.sq: Dërgoja atij që merret me klientët e tu.
lines.en: Send it to the person who deals with your clients.
lines.visual: Back to the frame-1 chat list: the threads sink again, except the lit one that stays on top (loop to the hook). End card.
